C1.worst_defect: The hero promises it "keeps selling when the connection drops" without the keep-the-tab-open condition, which only appears in the first feature card below; and on phone the header shows only "Docs" and "Live demo", so the cashier page "At the till" is hidden behind the menu.

C2.worst_defect: For an own store, refunds are "Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls", stated as a bare fact with no plain line that a non-developer owner will need their developer for every refund.
C2.where: home (live demo vs own store table, Refund row) / limitations.desktop.01

C3.worst_defect: No recommended counter device: "tablets and phones, an iPad included, are not tested yet" and tests "run in desktop Chrome" leave the owner guessing what hardware to put on the counter tomorrow.

C4.worst_defect: The docs Overview "Next steps" cards are only Quick start, Live demo, Plugin setup and Source on GitHub: no At the till or Limitations card, so an owner arriving at Docs is pointed only at developer setup.

C5.worst_defect: The cashier-sheet and closure screenshots on At the till sit as a small inner card inside a wide, mostly empty double frame, which looks unfinished next to the full-width payment screenshot.

C6.worst_defect: At the till runs to 9 phone slices, and the only way to jump to "If the internet drops" or closing the day is the collapsed "On this page" dropdown; the phone home header also hides Quick start and At the till.

C7.worst_defect: Lighthouse still flags "unused JavaScript" (53 KiB), legacy JavaScript (14 KiB) and 150 ms render-blocking; otherwise titles, JSON-LD, share card, llms.txt, search API, sitemap and 404 are all sound.

overall_worst.defect: The docs Overview 'Next steps' offers only developer setup (Quick start, Plugin setup, GitHub) and no At the till or Limitations card, so a shop owner opening Docs to learn how staff sell, ride out an outage and close the day is not shown where that lives.
overall_worst.fix: Add an 'At the till' card (open the register, take payment, close the day) and a 'Limitations' card to the Overview Next steps.
